about: SHA-256 of the RGB bytes of collision_cases.cases() rendered on api/_lib/styles/collision (step B of the seed change and the plan freeze, WP7B: the seed from the eyes' ids and the default seed key of the design; the pixel decisions made once on a copy of the canonical scene and recorded in frozen), synthetic irises of synth_iris, the production switches. The step A recording (the scratch code, the prototype's seed) is kept in data/stepA/ and replayed with the old seed.
